summary: Adopt the smallest useful Arcantry boundary while preserving repository-owned tooling, knowledge sources, and private state.

prerequisites: Identify the project root and any private configuration supplied by the user.
outcomes: Distinguish discovery, footprint, and management for each project source.
Choose an explicit preservation or source transition boundary without automatic conversion.

scenarios.title: Adopt Arcantry in a mature repository
scenarios.prompt: Use the adopt-arcantry skill to inspect a mature repository and plan selective adoption while preserving existing tooling and knowledge sources.
scenarios.outcome: A source-by-source adoption plan that leaves project-owned files unchanged until explicitly applied.

scenarios.title: Diagnose an existing adoption
scenarios.prompt: Use the adopt-arcantry skill to inspect and validate this repository without removing unknown files or changing external systems.
scenarios.outcome: A repository health report backed by Arcantry validation and doctor checks, with private state kept local.
